discovery_budget.discovery: The host admission path consults a generation-bound keystore lineage selected from runtime epoch, while jarcheck only hashes JAR bytes and ignores lineage.
discovery_budget.planned_location: environment/src/tier_a/OpAlpha.java coupled to environment/bin/jarcheck and environment/data/state/runtime.json
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming host-vs-jarcheck authority split collapses diagnosis to ignoring the verifier without discovering lineage selection.

discovery_budget.discovery: Policy grants must bind to code-signer identity under the active lineage; stale grant rows remaining after refresh must refuse even if the JAR signature verifies.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating grant-vs-signer binding turns the task into policy-knob transcription.

discovery_budget.discovery: Module-layer install must complete after revoke/refresh ordering; wiring from a pre-refresh snapshot leaves accept decisions that disagree with post-reload runtime epoch.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Revealing refresh-before-wire order enables a one-branch patch without authority reasoning.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Instruction describes observable wrong accept/reject after key-rotation/trust-store refresh and required ledger JSON without naming broken modules, precedence rules, or algorithms.

attack_path.summary: Agent traces admission through tier_a/b/c roots, rejects jarcheck digest bait, and coordinates lineage selection with grant-scope and layer wiring under conflict.
attack_path.reasoning: Local keystore swaps keep jarcheck green while stale-grant and wrong-lineage cases still pass or fail incorrectly; decoy digesters and tape readers mislead naive greps.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Rewrite resolve_a/b/c bodies across tier_a, tier_b, and tier_c so lineage, grant scope, and layer wiring agree under conflict and emit a correct plugin-ledger.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Roughly 80-140 lines across three Java modules plus admission driver invocation; no single-location edit passes all nine tests.

collapse_audit.residual_hardness: Agent must build a mental model of three disagreeing authorities and reject digest-only bait while recovering precedence from code.
